review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_ENGINE_IMAGE set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second record, status-consumers.json, holding the engine image digest and the resolutions. MEASURED by static analysis of the owner-supplied decrypted executable (byte windows pinned in the acceptance test): SONIC and FLASH share one per-hit exposure effect (flag-word high-byte test 0x0a at 0x4b9d8c; FLASH is bit 11 passed to the exposure routine 0x42e840; the player gets parameters and the snd_stun or snd_nitro sound, any other actor is incapacitated by 0x4200d0 - controls zeroed, mode word 4, until clock plus duration); BEEPER (0x40 of the flag-word high byte at 0x4b9d95 and 0x49920a) places a timed beeper object on the hit actor, TIME from record +0x18, behind the admission gate 0x4b8ce0; BEEPER_SEEKER (0x80 at 0x441864) installs a per-step projectile callback 0x441780 that homes on the live beepers via the search 0x4b8b50. STILL UNMEASURED (none claimed): see the limitations array of status-consumers.json - the exposure formula and screen effect, the BEEPER-specific routine 0x499110, and the seeker's steering law. The claim is implemented: this awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
